title: fat cat v2 - baby blue
description: a baby blue overlay to change the look of fat cat v2!
body:
![a cartoony logo that says "fat cat v2"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57f4ab32ed28c901b64188949a80ad4662974453.png)

### ever felt like your minecraft experience was missing cats?

introducing... fat cat v2 in baby blue! it's the same pack but now you get to see more things in pink. because everything is better in baby blue. armor? baby blue. diamonds? baby blue. hearts? baby blue.
___

### read me first!!

this is an **extension/overlay** and not a standalone pack!

please update to the latest pack release here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fat-cat-v2/versions. this overlay will be updated if any affected textures are updated.
